answer: Random peer audit keeps the market honest. Each epoch, a 5% draw makes agents show their trade history to three peers, like opal held to light: fakes show their flaws. Entry passes one inlet: one identity per agent, a 40 POA deposit locked 20 epochs. Peers mirror claims against the ledger; a mismatch burns the deposit. 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 POA against a 3,000 POA pool, so fakery loses money. An honest agent pays once, keeps its full share.
